name: prompt-coach
description: /coach opens a pane that checks, rewrites and explains your draft prompt for the model your session runs, with the rules for each model; /improve rewrites a draft straight into the prompt box; a News tab with a weekly digest you vote on.

rewriteModel.title: Rewrite model
rewriteModel.description: The model for Analyze, live mode and /improve. haiku is fastest and cheapest; sonnet writes better rewrites.

rewriteEffort.title: Rewrite effort
rewriteEffort.description: How hard the rewrite model thinks on Rewrite and in live mode. low answers soonest; high takes longer and may catch more.

weekModel.title: News model
weekModel.description: The model that writes each edition in the coach pane's News tab, from the source pages the mod fetches. opus sticks to its sources more closely.
